title: Paper Towels 6-roll

drivers.name: Price increase (4.5% above regular)
drivers.evidence: Same price point (10.32) in 2026-09-28: sales x0.99 vs baseline. No prior price increase at this level with confirmed demand drop. Past price hikes not well documented; effect shrunk toward 1.0.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 96.5. No events or promotions are scheduled, but the price is 4.5% above regular. Past promotions show a median lift of x2.09, but this is a price increase, not a discount. The week after promotions sees a median drop to x0.82, suggesting demand contraction post-promo. A price hike typically reduces demand, especially when no promotion is present. The TikTok trend is unverified by past data and not a repeatable driver. The classical uplift model suggests no effect, but we must adjust for the price increase. Evidence from a prior similar price increase (2026-09-28, 10.32) shows no lift: sales were 96 vs baseline 96.5 (x0.99). Thus, the price rise likely has a small downside effect. Noise-adjusted estimate for price hikes is x0.95–0.98. We use x0.97 with low confidence due to limited evidence.

brief:
PRODUCT: Paper Towels 6-roll | category Household | Store #12 (Austin, TX)
TARGET WEEK: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-15 (5 weeks after the last week with sales data)

KNOWN PLAN FOR THE TARGET WEEK:
  events: none
  shelf price: 10.32 (+4.5% vs regular price 9.88)
  planner notes: Product is trending on TikTok

STATISTICAL BASELINE (exponential smoothing of recent sales; it ignores events, promotions and prices):
  median 96.5 | 5%-95%: 62.6 - 233.8 | 10%-90%: 67.2 - 191.6

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-23% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
